Actual conditional Gaussian covariance bound

Source: GaussianCapCovariance.lean
Namespace: NegativeVotingPolyhedral
Compiler: Lean 4.35.0-rc2
Mathlib: 065356127b1dc0016f66b7283ce0ce2c4055aa55

Let gamma be the actual standard Gaussian on FSC.Coord d, a finite real
Euclidean space. Let C={x: for every j, <w_j,x> <= b_j}, where the index type
is finite. Put p=gamma(C)>0. For every vector v, the main theorem proves

  (1/p) integral_C (<v,x> - (1/p) integral_C <v,y> dgamma(y))^2 dgamma(x)
    <= ||v||^2.

This is the directional statement that the actual conditional covariance is
bounded above by the identity. The theorem does not assume that covariance
bound, a derivative formula, an integrability condition, or regularity of the
boundary. Normals need not be unit, distinct, independent, or nonzero.

Proof chain
  1. Scalar projections of the actual standard Gaussian have their exact
     Gaussian laws. All exponential moments, and then all polynomial moments
     under restriction to C, are integrable.
  2. The explicit Gaussian density satisfies the pointwise exponential-tilt
     identity. Lebesgue translation invariance then gives the actual identity

       M_C,v(t) = exp(t^2 ||v||^2/2) gamma(C-tv).

  3. Positive mass at t=0 implies positive mass for every translate, using
     the positivity of the actual MGF. Gaussian cap log-concavity yields
     concavity of log gamma(C-tv).
  4. Consequently cgf_C,v(t)-t^2||v||^2/2 is concave. Its first derivative
     is antitone and its second derivative is nonpositive.
  5. Mathlib's analytic MGF calculus identifies the actual CGF second
     derivative with the normalized centered second moment, giving the bound.

Main exports
  gaussian_cap_conditional_variance_le
  gaussian_cap_conditional_second_moment_le
  cap_centered_square_integrable
  cap_score_moment_integrable
  cap_mgf_translate
  cap_cgf_sub_quadratic_concave

Attribution and scope
  The actual Gaussian cap log-concavity input is from Abhijeet Mulgund's
  MIT-licensed full-simplex-conjecture-lean, at the commit recorded in
  PROVENANCE.txt. The exact Gaussian law and MGF-analytic differentiation
  input is mathlib; MGFAnalytic.lean credits Remy Degenne, Apache-2.0.
  This module supplies a concrete integration proof of a standard Gaussian
  covariance estimate. It is not a new covariance theorem or a claim that
  the full negative-voting optimality theorem has been formalized.

Build and audit
  lake build GaussianCapCovariance
  lake env lean GaussianCapCovarianceAudit.lean
  python3 verify_covariance.py --lake /absolute/path/to/lake

All 17 declarations are audited transitively. The receipt and transcript are
GAUSSIAN_CAP_COVARIANCE_VERIFICATION.json and GAUSSIAN_CAP_COVARIANCE_AXIOMS.txt.
